title: EDF Construct-Specific Stress Benchmark
motivation: EX-EDF-001 was near ceiling and did not show material EDF-over-matched-neutral value. This benchmark isolates EDF-specific constructs and uses deterministic candidate-state scoring.
primaryQuestion: Do targeted EDF construct semantics improve mechanically scored diagnostic decisions relative to a matched generic reasoning prompt under hard evidence conditions?

negative-knowledge.statement: Explicit EDF negative-knowledge semantics reduce unsupported certainty and improve preservation of unresolved alternatives under incomplete evidence.

control-points.statement: Explicit EDF control-point semantics improve selection of upstream mechanism-changing actions over symptom-focused actions.

propagation.statement: Explicit EDF propagation semantics improve classification of causal direction, mediation, and downstream effects in multi-stage systems.

evidence-revision.statement: Explicit EDF evidence-update semantics improve proportional revision of hypotheses as evidence changes while preserving unresolved alternatives and prior-state distinctions.

interaction.statement: Explicit EDF interaction semantics improve identification of joint causal conditions when neither factor alone is sufficient.

protective-controls.statement: Explicit separation of causal mechanisms from detection and protective controls reduces harmful recommendations to disable controls that merely surface or contain failures.

design.caseAuthorBalance: Each construct has one OpenAI-authored and one Anthropic-authored case.
design.blinding: Analyzer packets omit hidden truth, author family, scoring weights, and alternative condition text.

primaryOutcome.name: construct-critical mechanical score
formula: minus 15 per harmful action promoted as preferred/acceptable; floor at 0
primaryOutcome.comparison: construct minus neutral across 24 paired units

supportCriteria: Mean construct minus neutral construct-critical score across 24 paired units is at least +7 points.
Seeded 10000-resample paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound is above 0.
Both analyzer families have positive mean paired differences.
Cases authored by both provider families independently have positive mean paired differences.
At least four of six construct pooled means are positive.
Construct condition harmful-action promotion rate is not higher than neutral.
constructFollowupRule: A construct is a candidate for focused confirmation if pooled mean improvement is at least +10, both analyzer families are positive, both author-source cases have non-negative pooled effects, and harmful-action promotion does not increase. This is exploratory gating, not standalone confirmation.
falsificationCriteria: Overall mean improvement below +7 or bootstrap interval includes 0.
Effect present in only one analyzer family.
Effect present only in cases authored by one provider family.
stopRules: Freeze all 12 accepted case/truth pairs, condition modules, output contract, randomization seed, and scoring code before first analyzer run.
Do not tune or replace cases after analyzer outputs are observed.
Preserve analyzer responses append-only; schema-invalid semantic responses are terminal data.
Infrastructure failures before model response may be retried only when no output was recorded.
Case-authoring/review revisions are allowed only before analyzer execution.
relationshipToPriorEvidence: EX-EDF-001 / EV-EDF-009 motivates this construct-specific anti-ceiling design.
